description: Multi-tenant SaaS backend for career-ops: API + job worker, S3-backed user data, Postgres job queue.
name: career-ops-saas

scripts.schema: node -e "import('pg').then(async ({default:pg}) => { const {readFileSync} = await import('fs'); const c = new pg.Client({connectionString: process.env.DATABASE_URL}); await c.connect(); await c.query(readFileSync('db/schema.sql','utf8')); await c.end(); console.log('schema applied'); })"
